pull_request.title: Cli
pull_request.body:
This pull request adds a cli with hard coded user configuration. It uses [Clap](https://docs.rs/clap/latest/clap/) to parse arguments.

See [the updated readme](https://github.com/GavinFrazar/teleport-challenge/blob/cli/README.md)

commits.message: Split parser out into separate module
Require dir since server and joblib expect it
Add constructor func for client wrapper
Remove unneeded helper funcs and fix clippy warnings
Make user id a cli arg
Handle broken pipe for output stream
Output only the uuid for easy usage

pull_request.title: Server
pull_request.body: This PR adds a remote job server API. I updated the [project README](https://github.com/GavinFrazar/teleport-challenge/blob/server/README.md)

commits.message: Rename proto file/package for better codegen names
Rework .proto names to be unamiguous after codegen
Move interceptor to its own module

Make dependencies version specific

May avoid some reproducibility issues
Rework the job status protobuf to do better codegen

Rework the make-certs script and CA cert chains

One root CA for servers
One root CA for clients
Handle job start errors gracefully in server
Add kill on drop to reap child processes (hopefully)

comment.body:
https://github.com/GavinFrazar/teleport-challenge/blob/083c6ce2e87205f50e820a378c3baeac248866f3/joblib/src/actors/worker.rs#L30-L36

This should be changed to use `.kill_on_drop(true)` so that the child process will be sent a kill signal when the `Child` drops.

This will especially matter since, as I noted in the readme:

 https://github.com/GavinFrazar/teleport-challenge/blob/083c6ce2e87205f50e820a378c3baeac248866f3/joblib/README.md?plain=1#L38

Just something I noticed while looking over the code and readme again.
